dataset_candidate.name: PowerGraph
dataset_candidate.task_family: cascading failure analyses of power grids
dataset_candidate.direct_semantics: real-world power-grid recovery and cascading failures

purpose: Test whether frozen HAOS-IIP features add predictive value beyond conventional baselines on an independently defined real-world system.
claim_boundary: operational mapping only until holdout transfer is demonstrated
no claim of HAOS explaining power-grid physics

frozen_comparison.primary: best conventional baseline vs best conventional baseline + frozen HAOS features
frozen_comparison.secondary: baseline only, HAOS only, baseline + HAOS, ablated HAOS, matched null

splits.development: tune baselines and frozen HAOS feature usage only
splits.calibration: choose exactly one HAOS feature bundle and freeze it
splits.holdout: untouched scoring split; no feature changes after inspection
splits.replication: second external dataset only after PB-02 holdout is frozen

next_dependency: Repair PB-01 controls before PB-02 execution so the frozen HAOS features do not inherit a known control leak.
